name: Amamiya Makoto
source:
The protagonist. He's overly serious and pessimistic. Because of that, he doesn't really care that bad things happen to him a lot. He has this attitude because his childhood friend died when he was very young, and to this day he still feels responsible for it.

He's always been getting wound up in accidents, and is wandering in the depths of death itself. He acts calmer than others his age, and doesn't stand out in class. Despite this, he has a lot of secret fans, and receives many confessions.
